correctness.rationale: For c=2alpha-1>-1 and u=gamma x^theta, direct differentiation gives r_prime = theta gamma x^(theta-2)e^u Phi(u)/(e^u+c)^2 with Phi=(theta-1)(e^u+c)+theta*c*u. For theta>1,c<0 Phi is strictly convex, positive at zero and infinity; its unique interior minimum has sign c(1-theta*u*) and crosses zero exactly at c=-((theta-1)/theta)exp(1/theta). For 0<theta<1,c>0 strict concavity gives the dual threshold ((1-theta)/theta)exp(1/theta). Outside the two-root regions monotonicity is strict even at one isolated stationary tangent. theta=1 has sign(c). Numerically checked source alpha=.03,theta=2.52 lies in +,-,+ regime and pointwise theta=2 alpha=.01 and theta=.5 alpha=5 counterexamples; no extrapolation from numerics.
